# Agent Journal (structured notes)
<!-- sections: ## Findings | ## Leads | ## Questions | ## Decisions -->

## Findings
- TASK.md: fix `autodoc_docstring_signature` to pick up ALL leading SWIG-style
  overload signature lines from the docstring, not just the first. No test
  changes, no commit.
- Cause: `DocstringSignatureMixin._find_signature()` (sphinx/ext/autodoc/__init__.py
  ~L1040) loops over docstring parts but `break`s after the FIRST docstring whose
  first line matches `py_ext_sig_re`, returning a single `(args, retann)`.
- Consumers:
  - `DocstringSignatureMixin.format_signature` (L1084) sets self.args/self.retann.
  - `DocstringStripSignatureMixin.format_signature` (L1099) discards args.
  - `Documenter.format_signature` (L406) returns ONE signature string, but
    FunctionDocumenter.format_signature (L1159) and MethodDocumenter.format_signature
    (L1635) already join MULTIPLE sigs with "\n" (singledispatch support), and
    `Documenter.add_directive_header` (L441) splits sig on "\n" and emits one
    directive line per signature. So multi-signature output is already supported
    downstream.
- Upstream Sphinx fix for this exact issue (issue #7328, PR by tk0miya):
  `_find_signature` returns `List[Tuple[str, str]]` (all matches, one per
  docstring part), and `format_signature` joins them with "\n".
- Plan: make `_find_signature` collect ALL matching docstring parts (no break),
  return list of (args, retann); update both format_signature consumers; keep
  `Tuple[str, str]` return for single-match backward compat? -> NO: upstream
  changed return type to List[Tuple[str, str]] and updated both call sites.
  DocstringStripSignatureMixin uses retann of first match only.
